scope: Source status for srg(99,14,1,2), the induced-C6/n3 endpoint, named Wave19 structural reductions, Baker 2026, and the Fable/Jacobian announcement as a source-type control.
status_rule: Only an exact, inspectable source can establish prior art. Abstracts and announcements establish disclosure status but do not substitute for a proof. Negative searches do not establish novelty.

sources.authors_or_owner: Robert R. Petro and Connor M. Phillips
sources.title: On clique graphs and clique regular graphs
sources.date_or_version: Discrete Mathematics 349(3), March 2026, article 114862; arXiv submitted 2025-02-25
sources.source_type: peer-reviewed journal article with author preprint
sources.exact_status: Treats (99,14,1,2) as a long-standing existence question and derives the spectrum of its hypothetical triangle-clique graph.
sources.relevance: Current related result, but no construction or nonexistence proof and no occurrence of the named Wave19 reductions.

sources.title: Approaching the Conway-99 problem using SAT solvers
sources.exact_status: Reports that the tested SAT approach is incapable of handling the problem in reasonable time and motivates better strategies to find the graph or prove nonexistence.
sources.relevance: 2026 evidence that the problem was still being approached as unresolved; not a proof or certificate.

sources.title: The Lower Bound for Number of Hexagons in Strongly Regular Graphs with Parameters lambda=1 and mu=2
sources.exact_status: Derives n12 = n*k*(k-2)*(2*k^2-21*k+53)/12 + n3 and uses only n3 >= 0 for the published lower bound. The conclusion treats n3=0 as conjectural and cites a conditional Makhnev nonexistence result.
sources.relevance: The exact induced-C6 affine formula and baseline are prior art; this source does not prove n3 >= 63.

sources.title: The Subgraphs of Order Six of the Family of Strongly Regular Graphs with Parameters lambda=1 and mu=2
sources.location: printed p.2 (n3 declared free/unknown), p.5 (n12 formula), pp.16–19 (formula summary), pp.23–24 (Conclusion)
sources.exact_status: All six-vertex subgraph counts are expressed using the additional unknown n3; n12 has the same affine formula. The paper does not resolve n3 and does not state the bound n3 >= 63.
sources.relevance: Closest source for the induced-C6 endpoint. It makes the base formula non-novel but leaves the proposed strengthening unresolved.

sources.authors_or_owner: Rayan Ibrahim, Hudson LaFayette, and Kevin McCall
sources.title: Minimum 2-percolating sets in 2-connected, diameter 2 graphs
sources.exact_status: States that existence of (99,14,1,2) is unknown and proves a hypothetical graph contains at most 231 induced copies of K3 square K3, with percolation equivalences.
sources.relevance: Nearby K3,3-related literature because K3 square K3 is the line graph of K3,3, but it is not the m=27 K3,3/triangular-prism obstruction and not a cubic-order-20/Petersen residual.

sources.authors_or_owner: Jasmine Lou and Carl M. Murin
sources.title: On the Strongly Regular Graph of Parameters (99,14,1,2)
sources.date_or_version: MIT PRIMES materials path dated 2014; no journal publication metadata visible in the PDF
sources.location: Theorem 2.1, PDF pp.2–4; Theorem 4.3, PDF pp.6–7; triangle graph discussion on PDF p.7
sources.exact_status: Theorem 4.3 proves alpha <= 22 and equality forces each outside vertex to have exactly four neighbors in the independent set. Theorem 2.1 uses a distinct configuration called a prism.
sources.relevance: Baker explicitly says his result generalizes the independence bound. The prism and triangle-graph material are near prior art, not exact occurrences of the named Wave19 reductions.

sources.title: Strongly regular graphs with parameters (85,14,3,2) do not exist
sources.source_type: arXiv preprint with computational proof and code reference
sources.location: abstract; Introduction pp.1–3; section 10 conclusion around printed p.22
sources.exact_status: Combines classification of small cubic graphs, exhaustive local enumeration, and Euclidean/Gram positive-semidefinite and rank tests for srg(85,14,3,2), then names Conway's srg(99,14,1,2) as a possible future candidate for the method.
sources.relevance: The broad methodology of small-cubic enumeration plus Gram constraints is prior art. No exact outside-Gram decomposition, r=20 identity, order-20 residual, or target obstruction was located.

sources.authors_or_owner: Ben Baker; Auburn University conference organizers
sources.title: An Induced Subgraph Paradigm for Strongly Regular Graph Constructions
sources.source_type: conference program abstract, not a paper
sources.location: PDF page 5 (printed program p.4), Baker abstract; schedule on PDF p.1
sources.exact_status: The abstract claims upper/lower bounds for disjoint induced copies of H based on neighborhood size, equality forcing even edge distribution, generalizing Lou-Murin, with application to Conway 99.
sources.relevance: Creates broad overlap risk, but supplies no theorem statement, hypotheses, proof, formulas, certificate, or exact match to the Wave19 reductions.
